What products fit a Chinese wedding site?

Red envelope sets, tea ceremony trays, decor, printable checklists, invitation templates, and planning guides fit the topic well.

DirectoryProduct fitAvoid fragile-heavy choices

Product fit

The strongest products are light enough to ship, easy to understand, and tied to real wedding tasks: red envelopes, ceremony trays, small decor, guest explanation cards, and planning templates.

Avoid fragile-heavy choices

Large fragile decor or hard-to-verify handmade items should be handled carefully. Early product pages should focus on simple, understandable categories.
